messages:
maria: Heads-up, ap-northeast-1 GPU pool is experiencing high node churn — around 60-75% of hosts reporting kernel panics and reconnect loops. GLB health checks are flipping. Can we start a controlled traffic shift before p95 latency tanks?

kai: Yep, seeing p95 spike for APAC clients. Propose gradual weight changes + shorter TTL. Suggested plan: 20% shift increments every 3 minutes towards eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Prioritize routing Dedicated/pinned tenants to their reserved capacity first.

jonas: Sounds good. Also pre-warm eu-west for long-context jobs: increase scale target and prime KV caches for top model variants to avoid cold-start costs.

devon: Checklist: 1) drain new conns from ap-northeast; 2) set GSLB TTL low; 3) apply weight changes; 4) bump autoscale targets in eu/us; 5) disable autoscale down for 15m; 6) notify support/status.

anya: Note: several enterprise tenants are geo-locked. I'll add routing-exempt tags so those sessions do not get moved by the GLB. Applying policy now.

maria: I'll start with TTL drop + a small initial weight nudge to test behaviour.

maria: /gslb update --region ap-northeast-1 --set-ttl 30

sre-bot: gslb-controller: TTL updated to 30s for region ap-northeast-1. change_id=deploy_2024_1715009876

maria: Incremental weight push:
curl -X POST https://gslb.internal.api/v1/weights -H "Authorization: Bearer $GSLB_TOKEN" -d '{"source_region":"global","weights":{"ap-northeast-1":60,"eu-west-1":20,"us-west-2":20}}'

kai: Initial weights applied. Monitoring connect rates, queue depth, error rate. Pause if queue depth > 120s or error rate > 1%.

sre-bot: telemetry: ap-northeast-1 connections -20% (90s), eu-west-1 +10%, us-west-2 +10%. No immediate error spike observed.

jonas: Autoscaling: bumped eu-west-1 target +30%, disabled scale-down for 15m. Started background cache priming for hot prefixes (24h window).

devon: Cost note — cross-region egress for embedding-heavy jobs could spike. Finance warned for any >4h sustained shift. We'll tag long-running embedding sessions to remain pinned if possible.

ops-runbook-bot: policy: 3 active sessions flagged geo-pinned to ap-northeast-1 to avoid migration. If unpinned sessions cause egress costs > $2k/hr, alert #finance.

anya: Fallback plan: if host loss exceeds 80% or new error modes appear, we fail traffic to fallback-models in na-east (lower-cost, lower-context) and keep auto-rollback disabled until manual review.

maria: Proceeding to next step: new weights ap-northeast-1:40 eu-west-1:30 us-west-2:30. Observed p95 latency for APAC clients up ~30ms (expected), error rate stable.

kai: Watch Dedicated routes carefully — dev teams, confirm no dedicated/reserved route flips.

devon: Verified: dedicated/reserved routes retain routing tags. No tenant flips detected.

sre-bot: alert: node_reconnect_rate in ap-northeast-1 surged to 1100/min. Triggering infra runbook item 2b (hardware isolation).

maria: Launching hardware isolation sweep on affected racks now. ETA ~12m. This is non-destructive since nodes are already draining.

jonas: If isolation calms churn, plan to ramp ap-northeast back by +15% every 5m until normal. Keep TTL short until stability confirmed.

devon: Support has posted proactive message to customers in APAC: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1715009876 — included mitigation steps and expected timeline.

anya: Finance estimate: current plan adds ~+$3.2k/hr egress. Notifying #finance-alerts and ops. Recommend auto-notify if cross-region egress > $2k/hr next time.

maria: Isolation finished. Node churn returned to baseline. Starting conservative rollback: ap-northeast-1 +15% -> 55% weight.

sre-bot: gslb-controller: weights updated. ap-northeast-1:55 eu-west-1:25 us-west-2:20. Monitoring 10m.

kai: Metrics look healthy. p95 within +10ms. No new error classes. Suggest keep TTL=30s for another 10m then restore to 300s.

maria: Restoring TTL to 300s and re-enabling normal autoscale. Closing incident unless churn reappears.

ops-runbook-bot: incident log created: 1715009876. Summary: APAC GPU pool host churn -> controlled GLB weight shifts -> hardware isolation -> rollback. Cost impact recorded.

devon: Thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and drop in #postmortems in ~2h with timeline and cost appendix.

anya: Follow-ups: re-run kernel upgrade tests on ap-northeast pool, add early detection alert for reconnect_rate > 300/min, and implement cost-cap auto-notify when cross-region egress > $2k/hr.

maria: :thumbsup: closing thread unless anyone sees regressions.
